Golden Egg
When your lucky to find one of these Extremely Rare Golden Eggs
then after completing a floor your granted 750-1200 YTPs!
Just make sure the birds don't see you carrying it otherwise it's bad luck.

Super Seeds
These sure'll stop'em birds when they're angry! As they'll
just forget about what they're doing and just gobble the seeds up!

Slingshot (Red)
This ain't not run of the mill slingshot! It comes with an Angry Bird!
Use this one to get a good hit on your target!
(Only one use so use wisely!)

Slingshot (Chuck)
This ain't not run of the mill slingshot! It comes with an Angry Bird!
Use this and laucnhes super fast and impactful than the red one!
(Only one use so use wisely!)

Slingshot (Bomb)
This ain't not run of the mill slingshot! It comes with an Angry Bird!
Use with caution and launch it like a bomb (go figure) and watch it explode!
(Only one use so use wisely!)
When applied would allow the birds to also be angry at any npcs the get angry at.
When applied will nerf the birds' Anger Speed, Anger Meter and Stun Duration.
When applied before loading into a level will mess with the birds' spawning weight/condition and cut them to only have less to deal with.
One of the ANGRIEST bird known to somekind, he'll let out his anger loud enough pushing anyone his way.
Second hand to Red, also the fastest thing alive! So fast in fact he even can slow or stop time when it's time.
The big boom of the main 3, despite being fun-loving has quite the "explosive" temper and which he explodes like CRAZY!
